scope:
Run the original complete Rphi affine FD on a real three-query domain-tangent warm.

Only the optimizer producer schema and provenance wrapper differ.  The
original boundary directions, three centered levels, Richardson estimator
and 5e-5 gate are executed unchanged.  The entire real zero-H J is held
explicitly affine; this is not a native solve at the saved field's new H.

direct_boundary.finite_difference_definition: Centered h, h/2, h/4 plus (4*D(h/2)-D(h))/3 at two consecutive levels

separated_boundary.finite_difference_definition: Centered h, h/2, h/4 plus (4*D(h/2)-D(h))/3 at two consecutive levels

physical_test.formula: R_phi = Z_nonmean f - cut_scale S(c) D(epsilon_h P(c) z_nonmean)
physical_test.native_height_formula: H=epsilon_h P(c) z_nonmean; unchanged full material trace
physical_test.quadrature: Independent fixed uniform theta and phi cosine sums; no quadrature-error certificate

resume_producer.merit: 0.5*||Wr R_original||^2 with Wr frozen throughout each model and its trials
resume_producer.damping_model: min ||A z + Wr R||^2 + damping^2 ||z||^2; q_trial=q+alpha*(z/S)
resume_producer.LSMR_right_preconditioning: Exact diagonal column norms of [A; damping I]; no normal equations

coordinates.scale_definition: r/t: (1+2j)^2; z: 1+(2j)^2; core: sqrt(wr_j^2+(2j*wt_j)^2); controls: sampled max of their 0/1/2 scalar jets, at least 1

resume_producer.merit: 0.5*||Wr R_original||^2 with Wr frozen for the entire model and all trials
resume_producer.damping_model: min ||A z+Wr R||^2+damping^2||z||^2 subject to Pz=z
resume_producer.LSMR_operator: [A P C^-1; damping P C^-1] with LSMR damp=0
resume_producer.column_preconditioner: Positive ORIGINAL UNPROJECTED column-norm diagonal; not exact projected norms

coordinates.scale_definition: r/t: (1+2j)^2; z: 1+(2j)^2; core: sqrt(wr_j^2+(2j*wt_j)^2); controls: sampled max of their 0/1/2 scalar jets, at least 1

optimization_warm.merit: 0.5*||Wr R_original||^2 with Wr frozen for the entire model and all trials
optimization_warm.damping_model: min ||A z+Wr R||^2+damping^2||z||^2 subject to Pz=z
optimization_warm.LSMR_operator: [A P C^-1; damping P C^-1] with LSMR damp=0
optimization_warm.column_preconditioner: Positive ORIGINAL UNPROJECTED column-norm diagonal; not exact projected norms
optimization_warm.query_selection: Three actually observed request20 RMS points; no replaced argmin or new scientific gate
optimization_warm.retained_rank_policy: Original normalized-row SVD threshold 1e-12; record all original rows and their leak

coordinates.scale_definition: r/t: (1+2j)^2; z: 1+(2j)^2; core: sqrt(wr_j^2+(2j*wt_j)^2); controls: sampled max of their 0/1/2 scalar jets, at least 1

linear_reference_source: Full completed real T112 zero-H J held affine at the actual new warm; no actual tail at its new H is asserted
